sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the unknown canonical IRI nltl:transverseFraming with the supplied canonical controlled value nltl:transverseFramingOrientation in the transverse branch. Preserve the prior repairs: retain the top-level maxCount 1 orientation constraint, mutually exclusive orientation branches, branch-specific operand/result presence and maxCount 1 constraints, recommended units, and no guessed datatype on qudt:numericValue. Complex-readiness permits the source formula to remain informational here; do not add formula execution unless explicitly required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the top-level sh:hasValue nltl:longitudinalFramingOrientation constraint on nltl:platingFramingOrientation. It makes the transverse alternative impossible and therefore encodes accidental pass logic; retain the orientation selection only within the mutually exclusive transverse/longitudinal branches, each with its corresponding formula operands.

Preserve the prior orientation-branch repair. The two alternatives still permit a plating node carrying both transverse and longitudinal orientation values to pass because each branch only requires its own value and neither branch excludes the other. Enforce exactly one framing orientation (for example, constrain the orientation property to maxCount 1 and ensure the selected value is exclusively transverse or longitudinal). Also add maxCount 1 to each singular operand and result quantity property, since the current minCount-only constraints can pass when extra competing quantity values are present.

Remove the xsd:decimal sh:datatype constraints from every qudt:numericValue property: the supplied canonical metadata declares no datatype for these quantity properties, so imposing decimal is an unsupported datatype guess. Preserve the existing plating target, mutually exclusive orientation branches, complete branch-specific operand presence, result presence, recommended units, and maxCount 1 constraints.
